title.narrative: A Path to the Phased Elimination of Malaria From Bangladesh - Bangladesh (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Bangladesh, Malaria, BRAC (BRAC)This program has the following goals: To ensure that Bangladesh is on track to eliminate malaria by 2030 – contributing towards country development and the Sustainable Development Goals.. The objectives of this program are: Reduce Annual Parasite Incidence to 0.83 in the 13 ‘endemic’ districts by 2020.. Reduce Annual Parasite Incidence (indigenous) in the 8 elimination districts to less than 0.01 by 2020.. Ensure universal access to LLINs amongst target populations in the 13 endemic districts by 2020.. Prevent the emergence of ACT resistant Plasmodium falciparum in Bangladesh.
